_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Opening the Easy Scribe upload box

description: Uploads a screen recording to Easy Scribe, which turns it into documentation: a step-by-step guide, SOP, tutorial or user guide with screenshots. Use it when the user wants a document from a video they have; it works before they have named or picked the file. In apps that show MCP Apps (Claude, ChatGPT), an upload box appears with the result, and the box creates the document when the upload finishes. Files attached to a chat can't be passed to Easy Scribe, so the user chooses the video in the box. Title, template, language and description are optional. Elsewhere the result has an upload link and a command; how_to_upload explains them. For a public video link, use create_document with video_url.

description.description: Optional: the audience, purpose or focus the user asked for. Easy Scribe sees the video itself, so this doesn't need to describe what happens in it.

file_name.description: The video's file name if you know it, for example onboarding-walkthrough.mp4. Optional.

language.description: Language to write in, for example English. Default Auto (the language spoken in the video).

redact_pii.description: Blur personal data in text and screenshots. Requires Easy Scribe Pro.

template.description: Document format. Default general. See list_templates.

title.description: Document title, for example "How to issue a refund".

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace from list_workspaces. Default: personal workspace.
